title: Fundamental- Strength/Hypertrophy
author: Dario V.
desc:
Strength and hypertrophy program based on the fundamentals designed for those who do not have much time and want to optimise the workout by obtaining the maximum gaining splitting the body in 2 zones.
Simple and effective combine cardio with your workouts to have a body trained at 360 degrees
